goal: Choose a training approach that can clear a two-dimensional floor on every register, including the two small ones, inside the budget cap and without a human in the acceptance path.

candidates.name: Calibrate-then-full, uniform recipe
candidates.rationale: Calibration is mandatory (A17.20); the small strata (ST3, ST4) are where the floor is furthest from baseline, so the comparison runs there; a uniform recipe keeps the manifest simple and the verdict single.

candidates.name: Per-stratum adapters
candidates.conditions: Re-enter if the uniform adapter clears ST1/ST2 but fails ST3/ST4 after the full run; four adapters quadruple admission cost and are not justified before that evidence.

candidates.name: Semi-supervised expansion of ST3/ST4 with pseudo-labels
candidates.rationale: Pseudo-labelled examples have no receipt and no lawful basis of their own; the manifest requirement (100% classed with lawful basis) cannot be met.

manifest.assumption: A sealed, stratified, uncurated test set exists for all four strata
ST3 and ST4 are the binding strata
All material carries a lawful basis under RD-RMS-07

objections_accepted.objection: capture-condition mismatch on ST3 (radio vs phone)
objections_accepted.action: noise/RIR augmentation candidate carried into diagnosis; production monitor named

objections_overruled.objection: phase ST1 first by value ratio
objections_overruled.reason: the objective owner wants all four strata evaluated in one calibration before phasing; recorded
